billingExportWindow.selectionLogic: Rows where usage_end_time is after first successful report and usage_start_time is on or before last included successful report

metadata.cloudBillingExportQuery: SELECT * FROM `katalyststreet-public.pmomaxbilling.gcp_billing_export_v1_018FC6_CC1985_24653C` WHERE project.id = "pid-architect-ehlu1" AND service.description = "PMOMax" AND usage_end_time > TIMESTAMP("2026-04-21 17:33:29.521103+00") AND usage_start_time <= TIMESTAMP("2026-04-21 23:33:51.305882+00") ORDER BY usage_start_time, usage_end_time, export_time
notes: These rows come from the Cloud Billing export table, not Cloud Logging.
Billing export rows are hourly usage buckets, so the selected records overlap the exact 6-hour test window.
The PMOMax service rows are associated with test consumer project pid-architect-ehlu1 / PID Architect.
